title: 29C3 Panel: Jesselyn Radack, Thomas Drake, William Binney on whistleblowing and surveillance
summary: A 29C3 panel with whistleblowers Jesselyn Radack, Thomas Drake and William Binney. They talk about what happens when exposing secret government power becomes a crime, and about surveillance abuses.
why: Recommended as a first-hand account from NSA whistleblowers, often linked in surveillance and Snowden threads.

quote.text: You may be interested in watching this talk from 29c3 where Drake and Binney told their stories in their own words
